answer: Each new identity must solve a memory-hard puzzle needing 2 GB RAM for 90 seconds before it may post, and repeat it every 7 epochs. A farmer running 1,000 fakes needs 2,000 GB and 25 machine-hours per week, cost growing linearly, while an honest user pays once. A sparrow-sized laptop can solve one; a walnut-sized botnet cannot cheaply scale. Validators re-check 8% of solutions in 2 seconds, and a failed check bans the identity and burns its 15 POA deposit. A bot that tries to wander across many addresses pays each time.
